projects.title: AMC Repo Clearing Limited
projects.description: Built a full-stack fintech platform for AMC Repo Clearing Limited (ARCL), enabling secure tri-party repo transactions, member onboarding, and collateral management with role-based access, regulatory compliance, and scalable architecture.
projects.longDescription: Developed a full-stack enterprise-grade web platform for AMC Repo Clearing Limited (ARCL), a SEBI-recognized financial infrastructure institution focused on enabling secure and efficient repo transactions in corporate debt markets.The platform is designed to facilitate tri-party repo operations, member onboarding, collateral management, and transaction workflows while ensuring compliance with regulatory frameworks. It provides a structured interface for participants, clearing members, and financial entities to interact with the system seamlessly.
highlights: Interactive weather maps with multiple layers

projects.title: Digivote
projects.description: A full-stack voting solution with React, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB. Features include user authentication, payment integration, User, Admin and Super-admin dashboard.
projects.longDescription: Built a comprehensive Voting platform from scratch using modern web technologies. Implemented secure user authentication, real-time event management processing. The admin dashboard provides analytics and event management capabilities.
highlights: Engineered a secure, event-driven e-voting system using MongoDB, Express, React, and Node.js, enabling transparent and tamper-proof digital elections.
Built role-based dashboards (SuperAdmin, Admin, Voter) with OTP-based authentication, multilingual (English/Hindi) support, and accessibility features.
Automated event workflows with cron jobs, real-time result tracking, and formatted Excel exports for votes and outcomes.

projects.title: Konsensus
projects.description: A collaborative boardroom management application with real-time updates, drag-and-drop functionality, and meeting integration features.
projects.longDescription: Developed a modern task management application with real-time collaboration features. Implemented WebSocket connections for live updates, drag-and-drop functionality for task organization, and comprehensive team management capabilities.
